name: requests
description: A collection of user requests/queries intended for benchmarking models on information-seeking and retrieval tasks. It measures a model's ability to understand natural-language requests and retrieve or rank relevant documents or responses across topics. Typically used as part of the MIRACL multilingual retrieval suite to evaluate cross-lingual and open-domain retrieval performance.
reputation: Part of the MIRACL retrieval benchmark family and used in multilingual IR research, but not as widely referenced as some large-scale monolingual IR suites.
